groups.text: Robots: bot swarm run and MuJoCo on the CAD meshes

runs.name: free motion vs one-line motion (donut)
runs.cfg: Same damage, two runs. Left: bots that can only slide along one line each (body model, noisy). Right: free motion, ideal dots. Different bodies and training: shows the gap, not its cause.

runs.name: free motion vs one-line motion (shape with holes)
runs.cfg: Same as the donut clip, on a shape with two holes. Free motion closes the cut; one-line leaves a ragged gap.

runs.name: swarm run (body model)
runs.cfg: 1,024 bots on an unseen shape. Four copies: no damage, cut off, squashed, scrambled. Damaged at step 32, then left alone. One-line body model.

runs.name: swarm run: donut (a hole)
runs.cfg: Donut, same four cases. Cuts and squashes are only partly repaired.

runs.name: swarm run: procedural shape, two holes
runs.cfg: Shape with two holes, same four cases.

runs.name: 6 CAD bots in one world (MuJoCo)
runs.cfg: Six bots on the real CAD meshes, each rolling at its own heading. Movement only: nothing reacts to neighbours, no repair.

runs.name: roll + quarter-turn gait
runs.cfg: One bot on the CAD: a roll (left) and the turning gait (right).
